location_exception_reason: Wooden cabin sourcing is geographically concentrated (Delhi NCR, Goa, Bengaluru, Thane/Mumbai, Coimbatore); buyers often prioritise local manufacturers for logistics, installation support, and timber species availability. Location signals genuine buyer decision factor.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Wooden Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged.
